The hourly R2 storage-quota sweep no longer warns on every pass about key rows belonging to deleted accounts. Such owners (SuperTokens cannot resolve them) are now counted as "orphan pending reap" via a metric line, since the backup-retention reaper removes their key rows when it reaps the orphaned buckets. The sweep only warns when that cleanup is demonstrably not coming: a bucket whose orphan stamp is more than a week past the 30-day retention window, or a bucket the reaper never touches because it is not workspace-backup-shaped.
